source: Exact 32 public DOI/source pairs from prior verified author pilot

isolated_research_lead.title: Assessing health risks and socioeconomic disparities associated with ambient air pollution and point sources across the United States
isolated_research_lead.author_identity_support: Same ORCID reported by public Crossref metadata on both works
isolated_research_lead.interpretation: Relevant topic and public author link, but no verified target WPO-award association. Research-only award bridge, not a reviewer or REACH candidate.

caveats: The exact 32 DOI lead snapshot was used, not a fresh Crossref author search; the fresh query drifted from 32 to 25, demonstrating non-reproducibility without saved sources.
Crossref exact-DOI metadata availability was inconsistent: a previous run lacked one record, while final calibrated replay lacked six. Missing metadata is never treated as proof of irrelevance.
The topic profile is tied specifically to the atmospheric/air-quality work represented by award NA22OAR4590515; it is not a universal NOAA weather-research relevance classifier.
Matching public ORCID identifies a bibliographic author link, not proof of target award support.
A different registered NOAA grant cannot prove the target award was absent, and missing funding metadata is not evidence against eligibility.
This case set does not contain independently labeled new WPO funded positives, so recall and false-exclusion rates are not yet measurable.
next_decision: Retain safeguards for manual-only author discovery research. Do not schedule hourly before source checkpoint persistence, stable metadata caching, separate project-topic profiles and human-independent gold-label validation.
